digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and operator-attested completion evidence
propositions: Operator-attested evidence describes location of evidence (outside codebase), not identity of the actor recording it, allowing agents to document truthful observed evidence

The [operator-attested] criterion tag must be added to plan description text before plan review is signed, because adding it afterward changes material fingerprint and invalidates the signed attestation
Concrete evidence may be recorded in ticket comments after plan certification without invalidating review, because comments are non-material and do not alter the signed plan fingerprint
Documentation and guidance must clearly order the sequence: classify criterion with [operator-attested] tag before review, then record concrete evidence in comments afterward
Existing safeguards for exact-tag matching, concrete specificity, and command-versus-attestation distinction remain unchanged in the implementation and design
